summary: SSR Mining Inc. filed an 8-K on May 18, 2026, announcing the sale of its 20% equity interest in the Hod Maden development project to Lidya Mines in exchange for an uncapped 4.0% net smelter return royalty. SSR Mining also relinquishes operatorship. Total invested capital in the project was approximately $243 million. Separately, Royal Gold will sell 15% of its interest to Lidya Mines for a 2.5% NSR and holds a fixed-price call right to acquire 2.0% of SSR Mining's NSR for $160 million post-commercial production, plus consent and ROFR rights. Post-closing, Lidya Mines owns 85%, Royal Gold 15%. The transaction is accretive for SSR Mining. Watch for regulatory clearance and commercial production milestones.
